role: The skeleton's daylight shelter goal: while burning in daylight and under the sky, search 10 random offsets for a shaded spot with negative block-path weight and run there.

members.name: EntityAIFleeSun
members.note: the skeleton's registration: RESTRICT_SUN 0, FLEE_SUN 3 at 1.0 (ai.c:2837)

members.name: shouldExecute
members.note: ai.c's AIC_FLEE_SUN case: isDaytime as skylightSubtracted < 4, isBurning, then world_can_block_see_the_sky at the entity's column (ai.c:1663)

members.name: findPossibleShelter
members.note: the 10-attempt nextInt(20)-10 / nextInt(6)-3 search; the canBlockSeeTheSky and getBlockPathWeight gates were not verified line by line

notes: The daylight term (isDaytime) is World.isDaytime's skylightSubtracted < 4, which is what an->skylight carries, so the approximation is faithful for the daytime half but not for the sky-access half.
